notes.title: WHO'S WHO 2.0 Hotfix Notes
notes.content:
[p]We’ve implemented the following fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][h2]Red Light, Green Light (Official Release)[/h2][list][*][p]Mitigated issue where NPCs became increasingly aligned over time[/p][/*][*][p]Mitigated issue where Kai and Stinker NPCs entered tunnel or goal zones[/p][/*][*][p]New effects based on remaining time[/p][list][*][p]At 2 minutes left: Jet Kick unlocked (50s cooldown)[/p][/*][*][p]At 1 minute left: Movement speed increased by 1.2x[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where players sometimes couldn't move after respawning[/p][/*][*][p]Players are no longer detected by motion scan during respawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where motion scan duration could persist indefinitely under certain conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Motion scan now fires lasers faster as the scan duration increases
(Laser delay significantly reduced when many players move)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bombs Away[/h2][list][*][p]Slight increase in revealed position display duration[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now visually see how their position is revealed[/p][/*][/list][h2]Character Lab (Bird Eye)[/h2][list][*][p]Minor map structure adjustments[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issue where room code was not visible to non-host players in private rooms[/p][/*][*][p]Additional terrain fixes on Swimming Pool map (stairs)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where killer nickname was not shown when dying by Love Shot[/p][/*][*][p]Luna unlock condition changed:[/p][list][*][p]Previous: Play 20 matches in a group (Social butterfly)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated: 3 consecutive wins (Winning Habbit)[/p][/*][/list][p]※ Players who have already unlocked Luna with the previous condition can continue to use her.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re always listening to your feedback and working to apply changes quickly.
Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm.[/p][p]Nightvendors Studio[/p]

notes.title: WHO'S WHO 2.0 Hotfix Notice
notes.content: [p]To provide a more stable and enjoyable gameplay experience, we have addressed several issues in modes, maps, and characters, and made balance adjustments. The main changes are as follows:[/p][p][b]■ Modes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Bombs Away[/b]: Slight increase in average play time, reduced location reveal interval, added pre-reveal warning notification[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coupon Frenzy[/b]: Respawn effect size reduced[/p][/*][/list][p][b]■ Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Stone Garden[/b]: Removed obstacle collision from plants[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swimming Pool[/b]: Minor adjustments to detailed structures[/p][/*][*][p][b]Castle[/b]: Final red zone location improved[/p][/*][*][p][b]General[/b]: Fixed unintended objects blocking vision (e.g. vines, parasols, ceiling decorations), mitigated unstable movement on stairs/slopes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]■ Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Shark[/b]: Fixed bug where players within skill range were not hit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monitor[/b]: Fixed bug where players within range were not stunned, slightly increased skill range[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue working to improve your experience. Thank you for playing.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Nightvendors Studio[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Dear Real Players

Thank you for enjoying the game we love as a developer.
We did not expect so many downloads to happen even though the game has turned free.
There are many issues that we did not find on our own before.
We will assure you that we will be taking care of all the rising issues. 
We have fixed few issues that we saw already.
1. have fixed some spots in the map that was not functioning properly.
2. have fixed new modes where the characters not coming out as intended.
3. have fixed unneccesarry connection to other servers that are faraway from the users. 
4. have fixed other characters being selected in new mode and birdeye mode. 

We wanted to add features where players could join the game by following their friends on Steam.
but unfortunately it looks like it might take a little development time from our side.
We think this friend following system through Steam would be possible by next week.
Following up with this function, Finding the room to join feature will be added next. 

If you do find any bugs or have ideas that could improve the game, 
please leave us a comment on Steam or Discord.
We will follow up on the user's needs as much as possible.
Thank you

Nightvendors Studio

notes.title: End of Event & Upcoming Updates!
notes.content:
Dear Real Players!

Thank you so much for being enthusiastic. 
We appreciate all the players who have attended the event!
We ran out of keys much faster than we thought.
Through this event, Wish we could have done little something for all the Streamers as well. 

Also we have made minor updates in the game.
Bug fix & Balance Patch
* Map bug fixed for exhibition map
* Shark skill bug fixed
* Birdeye animation bug fixed
* EMP attack range increased (3M - 4M)
* Fried nerfed (cannot move when the skill is activated)
* Lobby scene enhanced
* Collection UI updated
* Can select the achievements as medal

Upcoming updates
1. New outfit will soon be available for 10 characters as DLC. 
2. New achievements coming soon. 
3. 3 new characters coming soon.
4. 3 new maps coming soon.
5. New character lab mode coming soon.

Stay tuned for the upcoming updates!
The game will go free when all the updates are properly implemented.
Wish we could finish all the update within this month. 
 
We will try our best to make the game better.
Always wish our game could bring a little laughter in your daily life. 
Also leave comments or ideas about new modes or characters.
You can always leave the comment in Steam or let us know on Discord.
We welcome all the ideas that could improve our game.
Thank you

Nightvendors Studio

notes.title: Who's Who 2.0 Update news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505260/a2ee70ea8a51ebf7a997bed0f0c75f2d7d358593.png[/img]
Dear Real Players
Thank you for all the support you have given.
There are multiple videos being uploaded on different platforms.
It gave us a good opportunity to look into our game once more. 
We found that some of the characters and modes required some rework.
We have gathered user and streamer feedbacks and applied it on the update. 

* System update *

Login issue due to some outer firewall have been modified. 

* Character update *

Hina - Now small marker will appear on the NPC when Hina says hi. The one with the markers are the NPCs. Look for the ones who don't have any markers. 

Ghost - Ghost was way more powerful than we thought it would be. The skill effect time have been decreased from 5 seconds to 3seconds. 

* Mode update *
Event mode has now been changed to Coupon Frenzy.
You can now continue collecting the coupons after being attacked. 
When you are attacked by another player, you will now be knocked out for 4 seconds and teleport to new area on the map to continue collecting the coupons. Now, large coupons worth 50 points will appear — block others from getting them!
The game time has also been reduced from 7 minutes to 5, and every minute, a coupon will be converted into a gift.


Team Coupon Frenzy mode has been added
Attack the other team and take their coupons away from them.
Protect your teammates from getting attacked. 
The team who has collected most coupons wins the game. 

Through this update we hope that the game becomes better
and would like to thank all the players and streamers who played our game. 
We promise to keep on upgrading the game.
Thank you once again for your support. 

Nightvendors studio

notes.title: Game tips for Who's Who 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505260/492a71617d57b3de109f0acb1593a93aad122fc9.png[/img]
Small tips for all of you real players before joining the game!
You don't have to know all these but it will definitely help you. 

*Game Start
- Quick play is easiest way to join a room
- If you like all the modes and map, press Quick play
- You can create your room by pressing Custom button.

*NPC tips
- NPCs do not run
- NPC's AI have been enhanced, they now do smooth 180degree turn, Watch out
- NPCs say hi to each other

*Attack tips
- When two players kick each other at the similar time, first one to click the attack button wins. 
- You launch your kick towards where the camera is facing. Not the character's face. 

*Movement tips
- Becareful when you run, your hitbox gets bigger by 1.5x
- Basic attacks can jump over some different terrain in the map.

*Character tips
- When Ghost is invisible, it's hitbox is decreased by half. 
- Luna can travel through the wall!
- Who's kick can travel long distance. 
- Mime copies players DLC skin as well.
- If anybody who does not say hi back to Hina? it is a real player. 
- If a chicken lands on you, run away from it. 
- If you see a clock ticking on top with a Cockadoodle, Stay still.
- Use EMP to get rid of the chicken.

*Mode tips
- Your movement speed increases when you have the bomb
- In eventmode, winner is decided by the number of present they have collected.
- The coupons you collected in eventmode turns in to gift after sometime. 
- You can revive your teammates in Team rumble.

notes.title: Who's Who 2.0 - We Are Back!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505260/7f9f3f9731cecd5be881645a72d579449fd8692d.png[/img]
Dear real players
Long awaited update for the game has ended.
The game is back with whole new development team and game mechanics. 
Total upgrade for a great game we loved. 

[b]What is special about Who's Who 2.0?[/b]

1. Made the game straight from the bottom again.
We have designed the whole game for easier and rapid update. 

2. Non-target attack! 
Now finding a real player does not mean you can kick him out 100%. Physical skills are required as well.

3. Unique skills for all characters. 
Each of the character now holds unique skills. We have offensive skills, defensive skills, utilized skills for your choice of play. Design your winning tactics with each characters.

4. New modes and Maps
We have new maps available. Each map has different advantages for certain characters. New modes like character-lab will give you time to master the new characters we will be launching on each updates. 

5. New achievements. 
Now the new achievements holds special rewards as well. Some characters that are supposed to be bought, could be earned by unlocking the achievements. 

Now find out the rest that has been changed on your own!
Whole new fun awaits.

We Nightvendors Studio are both developers and huge fan of the game. 
We are wide open towards all the feedbacks.
Especially the feedbacks that can upgrade our game. 
Any inconvenience, bugs or enhancement ideas, Please feel free to leave comments or talk to us on discord. We will always be ready. 

We will meet you all inside the game.
Please do enjoy~!
